title: Introducing of novel class of pyrano[2,3-c]pyrazole-5-carbonitrile analogs with potent antimicrobial activity, DNA gyrase inhibition, and prominent pharmacokinetic and CNS toxicity profiles supported by molecular dynamic simulation.
authors: Almaghrabi, Mohammed; Musa, Arafa; Aljohani, Ahmed K B; Ahmed, Hany E A; Alsulaimany, Marwa; Miski, Samar F; Mostafa, Ehab M; Hussein, Shaimaa; Parambi, Della Grace Thomas; Ghoneim, Mohammed M; Elgammal, Walid E; Halawa, Ahmed H; Hammad, Ali; El-Agrody, Ahmed M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新型吡喃并吡唑类化合物作为DNA旋转酶抑制剂，通过分子对接和动力学模拟探讨其与DNA结合位点的相互作用，属于蛋白质-DNA互作（酶-DNA）的物理模拟研究，但对象非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移，故评5分。
abstract: Microbiological DNA gyrase is recognized as an exceptional microbial target for the innovative development of low-resistant and more effective antimicrobial drugs. Hence, we introduced a one-pot facile synthesis of a novel pyranopyrazole scaffold bearing different functionalities; substituted aryl ring, nitrile, and hydroxyl groups. All new analogs were characterized with full spectroscopic data. The antimicrobial screening for all analogs was assessed against standard strains of Gm + ve and Gm-ve through in vitro considers. The screened compounds displayed very promising MIC/MBC values against some of the bacterial strains with broad or selective antibacterial effects. Of these, 4j biphenyl analog showed 0.5-2/2-8 microg/mL MIC/MBC for suppression and killing of Gm + ve and Gm-ve strains. Moreover, the antimicrobial screening was assessed for the most potent analogs against certain highly resistant microbial strains. Consequently, DNA gyrase supercoiling assay was done for all analogs using ciprofloxacin as reference positive control. Obviously, the results showed a different activity profile with potent analog 4j with IC(50) value 6.29 microg/mL better than reference drug 10.2 microg/mL. Additionally, CNS toxicity testing was done using the HiB5 cell line for attenuation of GABA/NMDA expression to both 4j and ciprofloxacin compounds that revealed better neurotransmitter modulation by novel scaffold. Importantly, docking and dynamic simulations were performed for the most active 4j analog to investigate its interaction with DNA binding sites, which supported the in vitro observations and compound stability with binding pocket. Finally, a novel scaffold pyranopyrazole was introduced as a DNA gyrase inhibitor with prominent antibacterial efficacy and low CNS side effect toxicity better than quinolones.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 微生物DNA旋转酶（DNA gyrase）被认为是创新开发低耐药性和更有效抗菌药物的卓越微生物靶点。因此，我们引入了一种一锅法简便合成新型吡喃并吡唑骨架的方法，该骨架带有不同官能团：取代芳环、腈基和羟基。所有新类似物均通过完整的光谱数据进行了表征。所有类似物的抗菌筛选通过体外实验针对革兰氏阳性（Gm+ve）和革兰氏阴性（Gm-ve）标准菌株进行了评估。筛选出的化合物对某些细菌菌株显示出非常有前景的最低抑菌浓度/最低杀菌浓度（MIC/MBC）值，具有广谱或选择性抗菌效果。其中，4j联苯类似物对抑制和杀灭Gm+ve和Gm-ve菌株的MIC/MBC值为0.5-2/2-8微克/毫升。此外，针对某些高度耐药菌株，对最有效的类似物进行了抗菌筛选。随后，使用环丙沙星作为阳性对照，对所有类似物进行了DNA旋转酶超螺旋化实验。显然，结果显示不同的活性谱，其中强效类似物4j的半数抑制浓度（IC(50)）值为6.29微克/毫升，优于参考药物10.2微克/毫升。另外，使用HiB5细胞系对4j和环丙沙星化合物进行了中枢神经系统（CNS）毒性测试，以评估GABA/NMDA表达的减弱情况，结果显示新型骨架具有更好的神经递质调节作用。重要的是，对最具活性的4j类似物进行了对接和动态模拟，以研究其与DNA结合位点的相互作用，这支持了体外观察结果及化合物与结合口袋的稳定性。最后，新型骨架吡喃并吡唑被引入作为DNA旋转酶抑制剂，具有显著的抗菌功效和低于喹诺酮类药物的CNS副作用毒性。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
